measures.title: City of Oneida sewer collection system bond
measures.summary: Asks whether to approve the Oneida Common Council's July 7, 2026 bond resolution authorizing reconstruction of the city's sewer collection system at a maximum estimated cost of $3,000,000. The city would issue up to $3,000,000 in serial bonds maturing over no more than forty years, backed by the city's faith and credit.
measures.yesMeans: The city may issue up to $3,000,000 in bonds to reconstruct its sewer collection system.
measures.noMeans: The bond resolution is not approved.
